request.text: An immense hooded alien serpent passes calmly. Deep porous chest hiss, slow ribbed hood membranes stretching with dry leathery creaks, textured scaled body gliding and a low descending throat vibration. Rich physical atmospheric animal Foley. No striking attack, jump scare, speech, music, weapon or alarm.

A giant crown shrimp flexes its enormous forelimbs. Two deep muffled chitin clacks, thick wet joint creaks, sequenced small swimming paddle ticks and a soft fan-tail pressure sweep. Huge vivid living crustacean, tactile cinematic Foley. No punch impact, attack sting, machinery, speech, music, weapon or alarm.

A vast veiled alien drifts past. Deep hollow slow gill breathing, layers of damp heavy silk-like membrane brushing together, fine granular silt-like throat rasp and an airy fading tail movement. Haunting beautiful tangible animal, cinematic organic Foley. No ghost voice, whispering words, music, horror sting, weapon or alarm.

A colossal coral-backed animal breathes once. Very deep warm rounded chest moan, many tiny porous coral branches creaking softly over its skin, a broad heavy flipper pressure sweep and long coarse airy exhale. Ancient immense living organism, physical cinematic Foley. No whale song melody, music, human voice, ship engine, explosion or alarm.

A giant crystalline cicada unfolds its long wings. Slow dry icy wing-sheet flexes, a low brief resonant thoracic tremor, delicate irregular chitin ticks and a soft granular exhale. Large mysterious living insect, detailed restrained cinematic Foley. No high piercing cicada buzz, musical tones, voice, machinery, weapon or alarm.

An enormous smooth hammerheaded alien glides past. Deep closed-mouth nasal growl, broad dense fin-pressure whoosh, subtle gill folds breathing and a clean heavy tail sweep fading into a low airy hiss. Controlled dangerous living predator, physical cinematic creature Foley. No sonar, music, human voice, attack roar, weapon or alarm.

A huge colonial alien pulses seven connected chambers in sequence. Rounded low liquid throbs descending gently in size, many fine wet filaments brushing, breathy gelatin membrane creaks and a soft uneven living resonance. Beautiful uncanny coherent organism, cinematic organic Foley. No choir, singing, musical scale, voice, sonar, weapon or alarm.

A huge thin copper-skinned skate glides with two slow wing strokes. Dense leathery fin folds, delicate dry cartilage tension creaks, low breathing hum and two separate whip-tail swishes. Sleek powerful alien animal, richly textured cinematic Foley. No metallic blade strike, music, speech, engine, weapon or alarm.

An immense ring-finned hydroid rolls slowly. Three soft layered membrane pressure breaths with muted cartilage creaks, deep central bell resonance, six smooth arm sweeps and a long airy liquid decay. Strange beautiful physical living animal, cinematic Foley. No portal effect, machinery, melody, human voice, weapon or alarm.

A giant sail-backed alien unfolds its dorsal membrane. Wide silky sail-pressure swell, a soft long rib-tendon creak, low resonant gill breath and two trailing veil-tail whispers. Majestic dreamlike yet physical living predator, detailed cinematic organic Foley. No flute, melody, music, human voice, wind storm, weapon or alarm.
